You keep making the same mistake.

en.text: Our names are the same.

en.text: I have no idea.

en.text: We never use this room.

en.text: I didn't spend a penny.

en.text: I feel nothing at all.

Strangely enough, I felt no pain at all.

en.text: Can't you swim at all?
